grades.quote: If the state still matches the earlier snapshot, then no other concurrent thread has snuck in and sold a ticket. In this case, the state is atomically updated and the method returns `true` , at which point a ticket can safely be dispensed. On the other hand, if the method returns `false` , then the enclosing `while` loop will retry the whole process, starting with getting a new snapshot of the state.
